title: LLM-wiki-lite boundary
summary: LLM-wiki-lite is a private semantic-memory helper that stays below RedCap's control plane.
body: LLM-wiki-lite may cache stable concepts and decision frameworks for AI and human maintainers, but every entry is non-authoritative and source-anchored. It must not replace task state, policies, receipts, Prism acceptance, source retrieval, or RedCap Forge public promotion.
